WITH state_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        c.state_code AS state,
        SUM(oi.price) AS state_revenue
    FROM olist.order_items oi
    JOIN olist.orders o
        ON o.order_id = oi.order_id

        ON c.city_id = oc.city_id
    GROUP BY c.state_code
),
ranked_states AS (
    SELECT
        state,
        state_revenue,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY state_revenue DESC) AS state_rank
    FROM state_revenue
),
category_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        c.state_code AS state,
        COALESCE(p.category_name, 'unknown') AS category,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
    FROM olist.order_items oi
    JOIN olist.orders o
        ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN olist.order_customers oc
        ON oc.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN olist.cities c
        ON c.city_id = oc.city_id
    JOIN olist.products p
        ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY c.state_code, COALESCE(p.category_name, 'unknown')
),
ranked_categories AS (
    SELECT
        state,
        category,
        revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY revenue DESC, category ASC) AS position
    FROM category_revenue
)

    rc.position,
    rc.category,
    rc.revenue
FROM ranked_states rs
JOIN ranked_categories rc

        category_revenue

WITH filtered AS (

    p.category_name AS category_name,
    oi.price AS revenue

    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN olist.products p

    ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
  JOIN olist.cities c
    ON c.city_id = s.city_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND c.state_code = 'SP'
    AND p.category_name IS NOT NULL
)

  category_name,
  SUM(revenue) AS revenue
FROM filtered
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC, category_name
